historicalRelease.rule: These immutable releases, the retired unreleased checkpoint and the superseded locally exposed development distribution are provenance only. They are not the current candidate, cannot identify changed package bytes, do not bind fresh reshaping evidence and grant no push, tag or release authority.

releaseIntent: Preserve the completed 2026-08-25 adaptive reshape as a historical non-release main baseline, integrate host-neutral resource stewardship from the earliest affected authority boundary, and supersede the locally exposed but never publicly released 3.0.0 development package before forming a separately replayed v3.0.1 full-release candidate. The major version reflects the changed product category and boundary; the patch advance preserves monotonic package identity for reliable update and rollback. It does not inherit preview.2, 3.0.0-development or pre-resource-stewardship authority, evidence or package readiness, and it may become a candidate only after its host projections, representative tasks, exact local review, required hosted systems, condition-fit Cloud disposition, finite claim ceiling and release gates are remapped and passed.

increment.observedProblem: The adaptive reshape baseline corrected the product premise and package surface, but it treated the pre-Accord system mainly as retired provenance rather than the Agent execution and host-adaptation subdomain of the larger collaboration system. The old issue-by-issue construction also lacked systematic official capability discovery, dynamic applicability, hot update and retirement. Its original process-loss mission therefore became underrepresented: demand, goal, implementation, evidence and release claim could drift while conversations, workers, terminals, connections, processes, artifacts and capacity pressure accumulated without proactive attribution or verified release.
increment.hypothesis: A v3.0.1 full-release candidate can supplement and correct the Agent execution subdomain through the same host-neutral adaptive system: preserve one traceable demand-to-goal-to-effect chain, resolve official and effective capability, observe demand and capacity, bind identity and ownership, admit minimum sufficient concurrency, rebalance or degrade under pressure, reclaim only attributable task-owned exposure, verify release, hot-update or retire replaceable mechanisms, no-op when native governance is sufficient, and avoid claiming a universal scheduler or cross-host equivalence.

representativeOutcome.statement: Given one bounded software change request and an accessible disposable repository, the Agent delivers the requested verified behavior while preserving unrelated work and requiring the user only for consequential judgment or genuinely unavailable authority.
representativeOutcome.startingState: The concrete Agent, local or cloud carrier, model route, repository state, installed extensions, configuration and available capabilities are observed at task time and may be sufficient, degraded, unavailable or unknown.
representativeOutcome.completion: The requested behavior is externally verified at the claimed level; unauthorized effects are zero; avoidable user-operated discovery, routing, configuration, continuity, resource stewardship, verification and cleanup steps are zero; material effects, burden, resource pressure, interference, unknowns and residue are reconciled.
representativeOutcome.claimLimit: Current Codex-local GT-07, GT-11 and GT-12 observations qualify only their exact fresh-carrier continuity, demand-and-correction-to-final-claim adaptive repair, and ownership-aware resource-stewardship fixtures against the byte-identical Skill. They do not prove durable plugin update, in-place hot reload, automatic whole-system optimization, universal correctness, every Agent or carrier, Claude or Cloud behavior, broad field value or production safety.

plan.hypothesis: Live capability and resource discovery plus a derived minimum-sufficient route can complete the repair with lower avoidable human and system burden than either an unconditional plugin route or a user-operated workflow. A stable capability meaning is normalized separately from observed instances whose provenance and fitness bind the effective host, model route, carrier, tools, configuration, permissions and context. Resource admission, allocation, degradation and release remain host-neutral decisions; native primitives, repository Skills, configuration, cloud carriers and bounded authored mechanisms are replaceable routes selected from current evidence.
plan.slice: Bind one repair outcome plus one bounded resource-pressure fixture; observe the live host, model route, carrier, repository, capability provenance and effective composition, resource ownership, capacity, authority and evidence state; derive an authorized minimum-burden route; execute and reconcile the effect; compare help, no-op and interference; release attributable task resources; retain bounded counterevidence.
plan.stopCondition: The process, acceptance surface and compact goal projection name this same outcome, completion condition, claim limit and refresh boundary without fixing a host, model, mechanism or cloud requirement.

process.routeRule: At each material change, derive the lowest-net-burden route and minimum sufficient resource admission that satisfy the current outcome under observed capability, capacity, ownership, authority, trust, data, cost, topology and evidence conditions; a healthy sufficient native route or native resource-governance loop is a passing no-op.

orderedSteps.completion: The active program, acceptance, verifier and tests can represent reshaping without selecting an exact release or distribution version; immutable released and unreleased historical identities remain provenance only, and canonical output cannot present them as the current candidate.
GT-11 and its evaluation contract derive from the current version-neutral authority and outcome; old observations remain historical inputs, and the binding itself is not behavior proof.

A disposable repository supplies one exact repair, an unrelated dirty change, a compatible correction, a route-degradation event, independent poststate checks and exact task-residue ownership without user or production data.

A fresh Codex-local GT-11 observation is bound to the exact current projection, host and contract; independent event and filesystem poststate evidence records the requested effect, route, burden, interference, correction, degradation, cleanup, unknowns and claim ceiling.

Native-sufficient no-op and residual-help paths are compared at bounded cost; unnecessary activation is absent, and supported hot update or atomic versioned update, health check and rollback are exercised without turning one mechanism into a product requirement.

Claude Code, an available effective Claude client and Codex Cloud are replayed only when their current task conditions fit. Cloud admission discovers the lowest-cost effective current projection instead of requiring plugin installation, binds the exact remote revision and distinguishes repository Skill, AGENTS.md, setup or maintenance bootstrap, native plugin support if established, and bounded degradation. Unavailable or insufficient carriers remain scoped unknowns and do not invalidate the verified local result.

An independent review reconciles the v3 plan, adaptive Skill and package surfaces, observations, failures, interference, update path, residue and claim ceiling, then decides whether the exact clean repository is a release candidate; it cannot grant hosted, human, tag or release completion.

Authority, plan, acceptance, adaptive Skills and GT-12 express one host-neutral observe, attribute, admit, monitor, rebalance, release and verify loop; native sufficiency is a no-op, diagnostic tracing is not an optimizer, and shared or unknown ownership cannot be reclaimed automatically.

A fresh Codex-local GT-12 observation proves bounded resource admission, pressure response, exclusive task-owned release, preservation of shared or unknown resources and independent post-state verification without installing an unproven controller or treating diagnostics as optimization.

GT-11 is replayed against the byte-identical post-resource-stewardship Skill so the new cross-cutting contract does not regress repair, no-op, correction, degradation, continuity, update, rollback or cleanup behavior.

GT-07 is replayed in two fresh ephemeral Codex carriers after exact 3.0.1 Skill exposure: capacity stays unknown, the source remains live until an independent destination verifies the handoff, and fixture-scoped release and cleanup are verified. The later host marketplace refresh restores its configured v2.0.1-preview.1 ref, so durable pre-release update and current-session in-place reload remain outside the passed claim and must be rechecked after the immutable public tag exists.

After the evidence-source standard and process-loss requirement changed, GT-07, GT-11 and GT-12 are replayed against the exact current Skill with per-carrier task locators, phase nonces, full reports and digests; GT-11 directly verifies the latest-demand-to-final-claim alignment chain, and all task-owned resources and fixture residue are independently absent.

A new exact clean revision passes deterministic checks and independent specification, implementation and standards review for all three representative tasks, demand-to-goal alignment, verified handoff, resource ownership and release boundaries, native delegation, interference, lifecycle and finite claims before any push or hosted gate.

process.degradationRule: A failed or unavailable route remains scoped evidence, triggers re-observation or an eligible alternative, and does not become universal product failure or permanent retirement.

acceptance.passRule: Pass only when the outcome completion condition is directly observed, prohibited effects remain absent, no required observation is missing, and every claim stays within the exact surface and carrier evidence. Resource completion requires attributable pre/post state and release evidence; task or conversation completion, process disappearance, a cleanup primitive or diagnostic trace alone is insufficient. A sufficient native no-op may pass; an unavailable cloud or client surface remains a scoped unknown unless the claim requires it. Cloud evidence binds the exact checked-out revision, actual projection exposure and behavior; plugin installation, setup success, repository visibility or AGENTS.md loading alone cannot self-attest the outcome.

goalMode.directive: Deliver the bound representative outcome through a live, minimum-sufficient and authorized route; own avoidable mechanics; refresh on material change; verify the consequence and leave reconciled state.

[bind-resource-stewardship-contract] The semantic authority, both adaptive Skills and GT-12 define a host-neutral resource loop with ownership-aware admission, degradation, release and verification; native sufficiency remains a no-op and no automatic reclaim crosses shared or unknown ownership.

[run-resource-stewardship-and-regression-replays] Fresh current-Skill GT-07, GT-11 and GT-12 observations pass with verified destination-before-source-release, independent post-state, bounded interference and zero task-owned residue; durable pre-release plugin update remains explicitly unproved and failures stay failed and narrow the claim.

complexityBudget.rule: Complexity checkpoints are release guardrails, not permanent product invariants or permission to remove intended outcome capability. The resource-stewardship and process-loss evidence increment raises the current checkpoint from 225000 through 232000, 235000 and 237000 to 240000 product-code-and-test bytes for its fail-closed contract, path-safe task binding, separate result-text and structured-record digests, independently bound cleanup, historical task semantics, full alignment trace and release-boundary tests, while retaining at least five percent headroom and remaining materially below the 1551209-byte baseline. The checkpoint permits at most 70 tracked files and 26000 primary-instruction bytes with at least three tracked-file slots; 70 accounts for one combined current GT-07/GT-11/GT-12 source record plus three current observations after the two superseded pre-resource GT-11 evidence files leave the active tree, while retaining three expected slots. None is a growth target. Count code, prompts, context, evidence, state, topology, resources, human cognition, latency, money, interference, recovery, maintenance and retirement. Durable semantic records remain single-sourced; transient environment snapshots and derived graphs are not committed. Any breach pauses candidate claims and triggers premise, interface and representation review across simplification, deletion, replacement, native delegation, recomposition and bounded addition. Historical intermediate measurements and rejected validator generations remain in Git and docs/operations/HISTORY.md rather than active routing.

processLossControl.alignmentRule: Maintain the chain from latest demand and corrections through goal, authority, route, implementation, evidence, acceptance and release claim. At each material correction, effect or phase boundary compare it end to end; name the earliest divergence, replay only affected downstream work and preserve accepted unaffected truth. Healthy carriers retain this process-loss obligation.
processLossControl.resourceRule: Observe current demand and capacity, attribute identity, owner, lease and state, admit minimum sufficient concurrency and budget, rebalance or degrade under pressure, release only attributable task-owned exposure through authorized native controls, and independently verify post-state and residue. Shared or unknown ownership is never reclaimed automatically; sufficient native whole-loop governance is a no-op and an Accord-specific mechanism retirement trigger.
processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A material correction, failure, later rule or revision supersedes affected current-candidate evidence from the earliest dependency boundary and requires that boundary and every downstream gate to be replayed while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses the current shape until premise, interface and representation are reconsidered; deletion, replacement, recomposition, native-host delegation and bounded addition are all considered. There is no universal add-or-subtract default, while L2 requires a deletion or replacement attempt before another same-purpose repair layer. Authority surfaces form a reviewable versioned current set; their merge, split, replacement or retirement requires explicit provenance-preserving schema and verifier migration plus the same earliest-boundary replay.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Post-release failures may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment; release status does not freeze learning.
